request_summary: Handle the secret decision, report the failing scenario only, update the PR testing section, then commit, push and reply to the review threads.

Rewrote the testing section of the pull request body preserving the template, and posted one reply per review thread with the commit reference.
Verified: remote branch tip equals the commit, pull request lists the commit, body headings and checked items preserved, six replies created.

outcome.detail: Fixes are published and the review threads answered; the issuer setup and restore path and the secret-based configuration remain unverified at runtime, and gec_002_09 is reported but unresolved.

notes: ACE trace files and ACE-generated instruction files were not committed because no trace publication was authorized. The replies leave the threads open for the reviewer.
